changeSet.author: lifefit-architecture
changeSet.comment: Ticket: LF-0055. Install the official Hangfire SQL Server schema. Hangfire owns job execution state. Index review: Hangfire's own primary keys and state/queue indexes. No application job-status table. Performance note: monitoring queries read HangFire.Job, State, and JobParameter.

rollback.sql: DROP TABLE IF EXISTS HangFire.AggregatedCounter, HangFire.Counter, HangFire.Hash, HangFire.JobParameter, HangFire.JobQueue, HangFire.List, HangFire.Schema, HangFire.Server, HangFire.Set, HangFire.State, HangFire.Job;
IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys.schemas WHERE name = N'HangFire') DROP SCHEMA HangFire;

changeSet.author: lifefit-architecture
changeSet.comment: Ticket: LF-0056. Grant background job monitoring to SuperAdmin only. Index review: catalog inserts only.
changeSet.sql:
DECLARE @Now DATETIME2 = SYSUTCDATETIME(); INSERT INTO app.Permissions (Id, Code, Name, Description, CreatedAt, UpdatedAt) VALUES ('22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222110', N'BACKGROUND_JOB_READ', N'View background jobs', N'View background job status across authorized tenants.', @Now, @Now), ('22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222111', N'BACKGROUND_JOB_MANAGE', N'Manage background jobs', N'Retry or cancel background jobs.', @Now, @Now);
INSERT INTO app.RolePermissions (RoleId, PermissionId) SELECT r.Id, p.Id FROM app.Roles r JOIN app.Permissions p ON p.Code IN (N'BACKGROUND_JOB_READ', N'BACKGROUND_JOB_MANAGE') WHERE r.Name = N'SuperAdmin' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM app.RolePermissions existing WHERE existing.RoleId = r.Id AND existing.PermissionId = p.Id);
